verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents audit logs, offering full audit logs through the Teams API (a programmatic export path) and a 7-day audit log view on some tier. The docs never say that the logs record which user connected to which machine and when, and no export format or hands-on corroboration is given. Missing for 10: documented log fields (user, machine, timestamp of connections), an explicit export/download format beyond API access, retention clarity beyond 7 days on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: Full audit logs via Teams API
API access for automation and reporting
